name: io.github.2s-io/mcp
description: Pay-per-call MCP server for 2s.io — exposes 40+ tools (geocoding, weather, climate, earthquakes, tides, POI, US patents, US case law, Federal Register, Wikipedia, scientific papers, AI summarize / translate / extract / screenshot / image-describe, image compression, DNS, WHOIS, crypto address-validate, EVM gas oracle, OFAC sanctions screening, US Census demographics, airport / ZIP lookup, and more). Settled per call in USDC on Base via x402 — no API keys, no signup; bring a viem-compatible key. Bearer auth also supported for pre-funded accounts.

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Hex-encoded EVM private key (0x-prefixed) used by the SDK to sign x402 EIP-3009 payment authorizations. Mutually exclusive with TWOSIO_API_KEY — provide one or the other. Funds USDC on Base.

environmentVariables.name: TWOSIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key for pre-funded 2s.io account auth. Mutually exclusive with EVM_PRIVATE_KEY — use this if you want account-based debits instead of per-call x402 settlement.
